mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_document (title, source, source_ref, chunk_count, file_size, content) VALUES (#{title}, #{source}, #{sourceRef}, #{chunkCount}, #{fileSize}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, source, source_ref, chunk_count, file_size, create_time FROM knowledge_document ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, title, source, source_ref, chunk_count, file_size, content, create_time FROM knowledge_document WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, title, source, source_ref, chunk_count, file_size, create_time FROM knowledge_document WHERE source_ref = #{sourceRef}
